author: Andrew Fisher

checks.name: patch leaves the original navigation body unchanged
forecast and Rehire calculation bodies are unchanged
patch refuses a second application without changing the file
patch refuses a base without the previous release
navigation shares one asset snapshot and rental lookup per key
baseline and patched navigation produce the same synthetic model
record replacement is fresh on the next navigation
same-tab redraw sees edited and deleted records
empty snapshots are held once and later additions appear
alert failure releases the cache and the next navigation recovers
render failure releases the cache and navigation flag
nested navigation retains its caller hold until the caller returns
scheduled frame and microtask read fresh records outside the navigation hold
a direct render after a record refresh remains fresh
capability refresh still runs on every draw after permission changes
unknown tabs and register aliases keep their original routes
forecast and Rehire builders each run once within a shared hold
standalone model calls stay uncached and read later record edits
new model holds and standalone calls cannot reuse a completed hold
failed model construction is not cached and a later hold recovers
a scheduled model calculation reads a fresh snapshot

limits: Unchanged standing CPU suite with synthetic in-memory records and extracted actual candidate functions.
No browser, visual or service checks; no record writes.
Historical patch applies only to a disposable temporary baseline copy; candidate, archived baseline and product source files are unchanged.
